race.description: Power Fm Ladies Day Oct 23 Book Now Mdn Plate
race.comment: Very wary of the nicely bred FULL CONFIDENCE (11) who ran a good race on debut at Sandown Hillside behind Regal Ambition who was an impressive Listed winner on Sunday. Up in trip suits, just not sure where she gets to from the draw but with any luck she looks ideally placed. BRAEMAR HILL (1) ran a good race on debut at Sale when beaten a head into third. Better for that and has claims although is another drawn wide. SO ROYAL (14) is a So You Think filly on debut for the Freedman yard who has been met with some early support and draws well, respecting. PANDIE PANDIE (12) is a Shamus Award filly for the Moody & Coleman yard who can run well from the inside gate.
